COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision as rumours only.
   C. Say Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision.

2. Which statement about Responsible Decision Making is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Responsible Decision Making as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Responsible Decision Making.
   D. Say Responsible Decision Making never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Conflict Resolution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution.
   B. Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Conflict Resolution as rumours only.
   D. Say Conflict Resolution never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Community Needs is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Community Needs.
   B. Treat Community Needs as rumours only.
   C. Explain Community Needs with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Community Needs never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr.
   B. Treat Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr as rumours only.
   C. Explain Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr never happens in Kenya.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

7. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   C. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Concept of Community Service Learning is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Concept of Community Service Learning never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Concept of Community Service Learning.
   C. Treat Concept of Community Service Learning as rumours only.
   D. Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

12. Which statement about Intercultural competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Intercultural competence as rumours only.
   B. Say Intercultural competence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural competence.
   D. Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Action Research and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Implementing an Intervention 4.0 Social and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Problem identification and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
